subject: Todaiji's present seated Vairocana / Rushana Daibutsu

sources.usedFor: Identity, seated bronze image, 14.98 m statue height, lotus pedestal and engraved leaves; official front photograph inspected as reference only.
Facial, ear, palm, middle finger and lotus pedestal measurements, photographed proportions.
Present curls: 483 retained; 492 including nine missing. The commonly repeated 966 is the original Nara-era head, not the present head.

landmarkCaution: Todaiji's page lists face length as 5.33 m while the tourism table lists 4.13 m. Their landmark definitions are not reconciled here. The photograph and the tourism facial table guide the face; 5.33 m is not silently substituted for 4.13 m.

sculpture.construction: Original native polygon sculpture with smooth lofted face, integrated nose and cheek relief, surface-conforming eyelids and lips, elongated ears, continuous torso, cloth relief, five-finger hands, cupped bronze lotus leaves and gilded relief mandorla.
sculpture.scale: Uniform visual scale of 4.25 / 14.98 to fit the existing garden hall. Hall and attendant placement are scenic adaptations, not surveyed reconstruction.
sculpture.curls: 483 instanced curl forms; newly laid out in staggered rows. Individual curl locations are not scan-derived and missing-curl positions are not claimed.
sculpture.materials: Dark olive bronze, aged gilt aureole, procedural micro-surface and subtle vertex patina. No image textures or downloaded statue geometry.
sculpture.performance: Lazy existing temple interior loading, coarser attendant tessellation, immutable material batches, indexed vertices and shared instance geometry.
sculpture.limits: Photograph-referenced interpretation. No access to survey, laser scan or rear photographic coverage. Unseen surface detail and ornament are artistic reconstruction; no 1:1 accuracy claim.

assets: Reference photographs are viewed for research and are not included in source assets or published site.
